_readme.title: GlowAssist AI — Med Spa Receptionist Agent
workflows_included: 1. Post-Call Processing — Vapi webhook → Parse call → Client lookup/create → Save log → Book calendar → SMS confirm → Package upsell
2. Daily Appointment Reminders (10AM) — Treatment-specific prep instructions per service
4. Weekly Report (Monday 8AM) — Revenue, bookings, AI rate, time saved
5. Post-Visit Feedback (11AM daily) — Star rating collection
6. Monthly Re-engagement (1st of month) — Lapsed client win-back with discount offer
medspa_specific_features: Service detection: Botox, Fillers, Lip Filler, HydraFacial, Chemical Peel, Laser, Microneedling, PRP, RF
Provider auto-assignment: Dr. Reeves (injectables), Dr. Chen (laser), Maya (facials)
Treatment-specific prep instructions in reminder SMS
Package/membership upsell detection and follow-up SMS
Revenue tracking per call (estimated service price)
Total spend tracking per client over time
60-day lapsed client re-engagement with personalised discount
setup_steps: 2. Replace YOUR_AIRTABLE_BASE_ID with your base ID
7. Update spa name, address, phone in all SMS messages
8. Update provider names to match real staff
9. Update pricing in the Parse node's service list
